sourceFile: 23. MSU-L20S15-07GMI  Report Test Supension-B changing tin plating method (From non polish to polish) - 2025.06.17_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Needs review because the draft has comparable Normal/Test evidence but misstates the changed factor and misgroups outcomes.
issues: Primary factor is too generic; title indicates tin plating method non-polish to polish.
Normal/Test mapping to non-polish/polish is not explicit in cited result rows.
Bond flux use differs in the welding vision rows and may be a confounder.
Module function rows are misclassified as tension measurements and missing as a function outcome.
Cited rows 37,39,51,53 are not shown in provided context, limiting verification.
requiredUserQuestions: Does Test mean polished tin plating and Normal mean non-polished tin plating?
Should bond flux use be treated as a separate changed condition or only a note?
correctionPlan: Rename the changed factor to tin plating method non-polish vs polish if confirmed.
Keep Normal/Test as condition labels and bond flux as subgroup or limitation.
Add module line function defect outcome using rows 64 and 65.
Rebuild tension outcomes by table and subgroup, excluding function rows.
Include visible row citations for all cited subrows and table headers.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Comparison citations are partly sufficient, but missing cited row text and ambiguous factor mapping block final use.
